SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading 5.2.1 Pre- reading together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Communication and Collaboration: A learner’s team work spirit is enhanced as they contribute to group decision making by recognizing the value

of other’s ideas during group activities.

• Digital literacy: A learner’s ability to interact with digital devices with assistive technology is enhanced as they engage in letter matching activities

in digital format.

Values:
Unity is enhanced as the learner strives to achieve common goals in group and pair activities.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Life skills (self-esteem)learner’s esteem is nurtured as they develop confidence in their reading competency

Links to other Learning Areas:
Reading skills facilitate knowledge acquisition in all learning areas.

• Braille letter cards

• Textbooks in braille and in appropriate font and colour contrast.
